meta.name: English (source)
meta.notes: English source for every locale. Keys are the English text of Cursor's UI, from Cursor 3.30.14. Values stay empty. This file is not a shipping pack. When the English changes, edit only this file, then run node tools/sync-locale.js --check.

scoped.note: Agents window: the app sidebar's Back button shown while Settings is open (outside the settings panel)

Appearance: the window-scale row (settingId zoom_percent). In Cursor 3.30.14 workbench.glass.main.js, Xs.Entry gets label "Zoom" and searchAliases including "zoom level" and "window scale". Settings rows expose those as data-search-aliases (space-separated; Cursor itself splits on spaces). Moved out of global exact (0.3.8) so other Zoom labels are not translated. Selector verified in the 3.30.14 bundle.
Agents window: the sidebar's fixed actions at the top (New Chat, Automations, Customize). Chat rows are never inside this selector.
Agents window: sidebar collection headers (Projects / Repositories ...). Only the collection band, not workspace or repository names.
Agents window: fixed group names that are not user data (repository groups otherwise show the repository name, which is never translated).
Agents window: other fixed sidebar entries. Group labels and section heads (user folder/repository names) and chat/project rows (global deny list) are excluded.

Agents window: fixed menu labels (e.g. the sidebar filter menu). Only menu items / submenu triggers / section titles; menu search fields excluded. Exact match only, so model, branch and repository names are left alone unless they are literally one of these words.
Fixed multi-word button labels in the Agents window (chips above the composer). Chat transcript / composer are in the global deny list.
Editor (IDE) window: buttons on the empty welcome screen.
Editor (IDE) window: the 'Recent projects' heading above the recent list (project names are in the global deny list).

Agents window: the 'Projects' section header (real DOM: .ui-sidebar-group-label-title inside the group that holds the projects list / its empty state). Workspace or repository names are never in this group.
Agents window: fixed names shown in sidebar rows where repository names otherwise appear (only these exact words; repository names stay).

Agents window: the relative time at the end of a chat row ('3h', '1mo'). Works inside chat rows, but only on the trailing time element; the chat title is never inside this selector. Exact values only.
Agents window: accessible names / tooltips of the sidebar's icon buttons (no visible text). Chat rows excluded (global deny list).
Agents window: accessible names of the small icon buttons / status icons inside chat rows (Pin, Archive, ...). Only icon buttons and status icons; the title text is never inside this selector.

Agents window: the fixed values shown in the composer's project / environment pickers. Found through the picker's accessible name (English or our translation). Repository, branch and machine names stay.
scoped.selector: button[aria-label$=", select project"] .ui-select-label, button[aria-label$="、プロジェクトを選択"] .ui-select-label, button[aria-label$=", select environment"] .ui-select-label, button[aria-label$="、実行環境を選択"] .ui-select-label

scoped.note: Agents window: accessible names of the composer pickers. {0} (repository / branch / environment name) is kept as is.
Agents window: composer toolbar and top bar icon buttons, the Claude Code import banner. The editable input itself is never touched (deny list).
Agents window: the 'Import your Claude Code conversations' banner under an empty chat.
Agents window: fixed suggestion chips under the composer ('Plan New Idea'). The key hint (⇧Tab) stays.

Composer placeholder. Drawn with one CSS rule on the empty paragraph's ::before (the same place Cursor draws it); the editor's DOM, attributes and text are not changed. Also any other ProseMirror editor's empty-paragraph placeholder (plan / to-do editors; selector guessed from Cursor's app, unverified).
Editor window: the 'Cursor Settings' editor tab (only the settings tab; file tab names are never matched).
Editor window: title bar icon buttons and the 'Agents Window' button. The window title (folder / file names) is not matched.
Editor window: Cursor's own status bar items (AI code statistics, Cursor Tab). Extension items such as Claude Code are not matched.

Editor window: Cursor's own items in the editor '…' menu (rendered in a shadow DOM menu). Extension items ('Claude Code: Open') are not listed. 0.3.5: also the agent pane's '…' menu items listed by tools/tour.js (Maximize Chat, Close All Tabs, Open Tab as Editor, Close Other Tabs).

Editor window: hover tooltips of Cursor's own title-bar / status-bar items (VS Code renders them as markdown hovers). Exact match only; VS Code core hovers are left to VS Code's own language pack. Seen still English in the 0.3.5 tour.

Model picker menus (e.g. Settings > Models > Explore subagent model): the fixed options are rendered as markdown (.ui-markdown), which is in the global deny list. Only these exact option names are translated; model names in the same list are not keys and stay as they are. Also the picker's trigger button inside Settings (shows the chosen option, e.g. 'Default'); the composer's model picker is outside these selectors. 0.3.8 (Cursor 3.30.14): class ui-model-picker__menu is gone; the menu is now a [data-component="search-menu-popup"] (ModelPicker popupSelector also includes [role="menu"]). Item names still use .ui-model-picker__item-content-name. The old __menu clause is kept for 3.28.x.
Editor window: the sign-in (onboarding) overlay shown when logged out. Fixed texts only; aria-labels are not translated.
Editor window: the shortcut hints on an empty editor group (labels only; key chords stay).
Editor window: the fixed actions at the top of the agents side bar (New Agent / Search / Automations / Customize). Chat rows are outside this selector; aria-labels are not translated.

Editor window, Customize page: the 'Browse Marketplace' button renders 'Browse' as the button's own text and ' Marketplace' in a span that can be hidden when narrow, so the Japanese word order cannot be reversed; '探す（マーケットプレイス）' reads naturally in both cases. Must stay before editor-customize-view (first matching group wins). The aria-label used in the selector is not translated.
Editor window: the editor tab of the Customize page (tab label only; its aria-label is not translated).

Editor window: the Customize page (Plugins / MCPs / Skills / Subagents / Rules / Commands / Hooks pills, scope select, headings and empty states). Exact match only; aria-labels are not translated; the search field keeps its value (only its placeholder).

Editor window: the agent pane on the right (pane title while it is still the default 'New Agent', the composer's placeholder line, the 'Log in' button under the composer) and the title bar 'Upgrade' button text. The placeholder is a separate, pointer-events:none element next to the editor (.aislash-editor-placeholder); the editor itself is never touched. Chat titles other than the default are not matched (exact match). aria-labels are not translated.

0.3.7: project/repository picker popup in the Agents window sidebar (screenshot 037, Cursor 3.28.7). Fixed headings, placeholders and the This Mac/Remote rows only; repository and folder names are user data and are never keys. aria-labels stay English. DOM not verified on the box (no sign-in): confirm on the Mac.

0.3.7: VS Code Settings editor (editor window, screenshots 041-047 of 2026-11-04, Cursor 3.28.7). Only Cursor's own setting descriptions (plain text, exact match). Setting titles are generated from setting IDs and stay English (VS Code does not translate them either); values, enum names, extension and VS Code texts are untouched (VS Code's own texts come from Microsoft's language pack). Descriptions with `code` spans or links are split into several text nodes and are not matched.

Quit confirmation (Cursor 3.30.14). The in-window modal is role=dialog (Cancel and Don't ask again already match that). The Quit label is its own text node; a keybinding child such as ↵ is left as it is. A bare Quit in a menu stays English.

Menus, tooltips, dialogs, toasts and empty states (both windows). The English text of Cursor's UI and its Japanese translations. Search/input fields keep their values (never translated); only their placeholder. aria-label is deliberately NOT translated here (Cursor's own code finds some elements by their English aria-label; visible text and native tooltips are enough). 0.3.8 (Cursor 3.30.14): class ui-menu__empty is gone; empty-menu messages now use data-component="menu-empty" (also menu-filter-empty, search-menu-empty). The old .ui-menu__empty clause is kept for 3.28.x.

Agents window panels outside chats: multi-word UI strings only (buttons, headings, empty states, accessible names). Chats, titles and the composer stay excluded by the global deny list. aria-label is deliberately NOT translated here (Cursor's own code finds some elements by their English aria-label; visible text and native tooltips are enough).
